title: Chat C — G1 DB controls and unit-selector contract
status: Static contract delivered; original-runtime equivalence and scientific semantics remain unverified

scope.assigned: G1: DB simulation controls, I[6]/R[3]/I[11] records, root+0x750, property reads, reset/default effects, unit getter/setter ABI
excluded: physical unit naming or inferred scientific conversions
scope.method: Existing retained evidence first, then 20 focused static function dossiers in an exclusively owned REA session. Pseudocode is decompiler output, not original source. Full export saved and owned session closed.

notation.S: int32 control record; in verified full-array 3D v11000 profile: M + (I[6]-1)*4
notation.T: float64/raw64 control record; in verified profile: A + (R[3]-1)*8
notation.B: control text bytes; in verified profile: M + (I[11]-1)*4
notation.indices: S/T/P/V indices are zero-based. Address table values and property keys are one-based. All scalar field names below are structural; domain semantics are not assigned.
notation.dimension: 1eb870 reads owner at C+0xbc0 and helper0015e0(owner) tests root+0x1c==2. The first pseudocode branch is dimension!=2; only dimension3 is admitted in current DB profile. The dimension2 branch mapping is retained without claiming a complete 2D loader profile.

rules: 1cc420 clears DB state before dimension dispatch/header/array import. ReadSimCtrl(1cf4a0) builds the record pointers, writes root counts, and calls1eb870(C,S,T,B,P,V).
1cf4a0 obtains temporary S/B records via1cf040 on the non-full path and frees them later; this contract's I/R address constants apply only to the established full3D v11000 profile.
1eb870 returns no status and mutates fields in sequence. It does not provide a transactional apply or rollback.
After ReadSimCtrl, coordinator calls235c30(root+0x84c), then proceeds to material import. C+0xfc equals root+0x84c.
Do not reuse KEY command semantics or apply every existing model setter implicitly: the original imports many fields with direct stores.

C+0x2e4 mode2 writes C+0x2e8=4 and C+0x2f0/+2f8/+300/+308 as double(signed S[72..75]); mode6 writes count4 and raw T[61..64]. Other modes preserve count and coefficient bytes.

table_layout.rule: 12fc00 clamps negative counts to0 and width<1 to1. 12fad0 releases prior storage, normalizes, then allocates zero-filled buffers. 12ff20 starts with width; for rank>0 multiplies counts; for rank0 width<2 returns0 except types b5,a7,a8,aa,ab. Negative product becomes0. Signed overflow and invalid allocation sizes are not safe-domain semantics.

table_imports.rule: selector0 sets rank0 and constant raw64 zero. Nonzero sets rank1; selectors1/2/3/4 map (axis0,mode) to(1,0)/(2,0)/(1,1)/(2,1); other nonzero maps(1,0). Then1309b0 with false flag. Finally1ee510: only when rank0, sets mode1 if double(C+1e0)<=0 else0; rank!=0 leaves mode.
If either extent<1 call1e9850: extents6,1, initialize typeb5,width6, allocate and write [1,0,100,20,1,1]. Else width=extent product and1309b0(false); rank/counts/type are inherited.

table_imports.rule: Read with1309b0(false) iff C+9d8==1 and C+9dc>0; otherwise backing remains as it was after the preceding clear.

table_imports.rule_3d: selector0 sets C+3c0 byte0. Then int(T28)==0 sets rank0,constant T29; otherwise rank1,axis0=1,read key int(T28). selector10 sets C+3c0 byte1 and nested3759b0 keyint(T58). Other selector values do not update either branch.
table_imports.rule_2d: int(T23)==0 sets rank0,constantT17; otherwise rank1,axis0=1,read keyint(T23). This branch does not set C+3c0.

table_imports.rule: selector0 => rank0,constant; otherwise rank1,axis0=1,1309b0(false). Key comes from the value slot, not the selector slot; retain this asymmetry.
selector0 => rank0,constant raw T slot. selector1/2/3 => rank1,axis0=3/12/1 respectively,read keyint(value slot) through1309b0(false). Other selectors preserve prior metadata/constant.
Independently call130dc0 only if signed key>0. Nonpositive keys do not initialize, clear or zero descriptor metadata here.

rules: Normalize counts/width first, even if the later gate rejects the read. Gate: rank>=0, (rank!=0 OR width>1), key>0.
start=P[2*key-2]; length=P[2*key]-start. Only positive length enters; metadata table+54=P[2*key-1], payload=V[start-1].

Rank1 type7c: allocate, axis0[0]=0, copy width payload reals as dependents. Other rank1: if width==1 set count0=length/2 using integer division; else use inherited count0. Allocate; each row is axis value followed by width dependents.

Other ranks: false flag uses inherited counts. True flag would read rank2/3 counts from leading payload reals; all direct1eb870 calls supply false. Allocate; copy each axis array consecutively then flat dependent buffer.
No bounds proof compares needed payload size against length; no status or rollback. Rejected key/length may leave normalized prior metadata and cleared storage from pre-import reset.
Normalize existing counts/width, calculate same start/length pair (caller ensures positive key); enter only when length>0 and payload[0]==10.0.
Store rank=int(payload[1]). Rank0: width=int(payload[2]), allocate, constant=payload[3]. Allocated vector remains zero-filled here.

Rank1: axis0=int(payload[2]),count0=int(payload[3]); count0==0 copies constant=payload[4] without allocation. Otherwise width=int(payload[4]);131ea0(payload+10) normalizes/allocates and copies interleaved axis+dependent rows.
Rank2: selectors=payload[2..3], counts=payload[4..5], width=payload[6];131e30 dispatches131fa0(payload+10), normalizes/allocates, copies consecutive axes then dependent values.
Unsupported rank still stores rank, performs no payload branch. Wrong tag/nonpositive length skips mutation except initial normalization. No payload bounds/status check recovered.
Same directory start/length; positive length and marker20.0 are required before list clear. Copy name64 bytes from payload+1, transform with324020(...,8,0) and trim.

first=int(payload[9]); requested_count=int(payload[10])-first+1.375600 creates at least21 type-coded tables8e..a2; if count>21, additional entries are typea3. Do not assume actual count equals requested_count when below21.

375950 forwards EAX from13c1b0(list), despite decompiler void signature. Count is list+0x10; list=container+0x40.136860 follows node+0x60 and returns one-based selected entry; caller iterates1..count.

For each nonnull table, typed130dc0 uses key first-1+ordinal.375520->136910 clears nodes via13c170(node,1), zeros list head/tail/count. Destruction internals beyond that helper call are not audited in this bounded task.
10 rows: strncpy80 from B+row*80 to C+0x688+row*81, then324020(destination,owner+0x748,10,1), then3239f0(destination,80).

324020 transforms for native*100+source in{1,2,3,100,200,300}. With arg4=1, reverse every4-byte group over80 bytes; do not perform the additional8-byte half swap. In mode0/native2 the result is four-byte reversal, not the full eight-byte reversal used by some object-name paths.

3239f0 scans backward over space/tab/CR/LF/NUL and writes NUL after the last nontrim byte. If all80 input bytes are trim bytes it writes at index1, leaving byte0. The following scan empties remaining all-space text, but an all-tab row retains one tab. Leading spaces before a nonblank character are retained. Embedded NUL still limits subsequent strlen.
Treat text as bytes; no character encoding, Unicode normalization or scientific label semantics established.

reset_and_defaults.supersedes: chat-c-db-model-contract.json broad wording that1e7da0 'resets controls': it is a storage clear, not a complete scalar reset.
rules: 1e7da0 releases backing via12f480 at C+3c8,4c0,538,5b0,1e8,a58,ad0,b48,9e0; clears nested C+440; sets C+328 and C+32c=0; releases C+330.

12f480 zeros axis/dependent pointers but does not clear rank/counts/constant/width/type/mode. A zero-count nonnull axis marks borrowed storage; frees are suppressed accordingly. Preserve ownership distinction without retaining original pointer identities.
Same-dimension virtual setter is a no-op per retained dimension contract. Consequently scalar fields and descriptor metadata omitted by a branch may survive import, despite backing being cleared.

Changed-dimension initialization invokes1c8c00->1e7c50, which calls seven initializer helpers in order:1e7e90,1e8490,1e8650,1e8fb0,1e96b0,1ea6b0,1ead60. This is broader than1e7da0, still not a memset of every control byte.

Initialization examples: coefficient count/values zero; vector default [1,0,100,20,1,1]; typed tablesa58/ad0/b48 initialize as b0/b1/b2; C+3c0 byte0; unit-dependent constants in1ea6b0 branch on existing C+fc==2. Exact initializer statements are in retained evidence projection; no new physical meanings are assigned.
The full native root constructor, transitive nested default values in375e90, allocator failure behavior and model ownership integration remain outside the completed DB field-transfer contract.

units.setter: 235c30(selector) sets DAT_1406fe778 to1 only for selector2; selector1 and all other values map0. Calls3f8b70 with the original selector, which similarly sets DAT_14070ba70 then calls3f9f20.

rules: 1cc747 CALL235c10;1cc74c MOV [RSP+0x20],EAX. This is after SUB RSP,0x48, so the entry store of R9B to[RSP+20] refers to a different physical stack slot.
1cc76b CALL1cf4a0;1cc775 MOV ECX,[R11+0x84c];1cc77c CALL235c30. Setter argument is imported C+fc (3D S18,2D S25).

Complete coordinator assembly contains no reload from post-prologue[RSP+20] and no later235c30 call restoring getter result. This proves the local ABI flow; no broader claim about every downstream callee's global effects.

nested_key.rule: T58 converts to int32, written as dword fifth argument. CONCAT44 upper-half noise in pseudocode is not a 64-bit property key.

refresh: 3f9f20 sets globalsba8c=6000,ba88=28,ba94=0,ba90=4; lazily allocates two arrays if pointersba80/ba78 are null.
Copies28 records at stride0x88 from1406214a0 into ba80: int at0, text at4, raw64 at68/70/78/80; then overwrites destination80 from source68.

Formats28 records at stride0x1f8 from140622380 into ba78 with sprintf and static format pointers. If globalba70==0, column130 is the string argument for writes to68 and194; otherwise columncc supplies that argument. The format bytes were not decoded, so exact output strings are unresolved.

No imported S/T control quantity is multiplied or divided in this setter chain. Refresh records contain numeric entries, but labels/scales, formatting literals and their physical interpretations have not been decoded here.
units.model_boundary: Keep raw imported unit selector separate from normalized global mode. Unknown selector remains in C+fc but selects mode0. A replacement should explicitly decide whether global unit presentation state is modeled; don't silently convert DB values or call an unrelated unit-change command.
